name: Diamond Resorts World Mastercard®

apr.notes: Variable APR 15.74%, 19.99%, or 24.99% based on creditworthiness. 0% promotional APR for 6 billing cycles on Qualifying Diamond Resorts Vacation Ownership Purchases, then 15.74%, 19.99%, or 24.99%. 0% introductory APR for 15 months on balance transfers made within 45 days of account opening. Balance transfer fee: 3% (min. $5). Cash advance fee: 5% (min. $10).

base_rate.description: Earn 1X Diamond Plus Points® for every $1 you spend on purchases elsewhere (excluding down payments).

categories.label: 2X Diamond Plus Points® on Diamond Resorts purchases (excluding down payments)

rewards.redemption_notes: Redeem points for statement credits toward Diamond Resorts purchases of $25 or more, and toward airfare and car rental purchases of $50 or more, made within the last 120 days. Earn 500 Diamond Plus Points for every $2,000 in spend (excluding down payments).

signup_bonus.description: Earn 2,500 bonus Diamond Plus Points® after your first purchase or balance transfer.

benefits.title: 0% Promo APR on Diamond Vacation Ownership
benefits.description: 0% promotional APR for 6 months on any Diamond Vacation Ownership interest down payment. After that, a variable APR of 15.74%, 19.99%, or 24.99%.

benefits.title: Low Intro APR on Balance Transfers
benefits.description: 0% introductory APR for 15 months for each balance transfer made within 45 days of account opening. After that, a variable APR of 15.74%, 19.99%, or 24.99%.

benefits.title: $0 Fraud Liability Protection
benefits.description: Means you're not responsible for charges you did not authorize.

benefits.title: Chip Technology
benefits.description: Paying for your purchases is more secure at chip-card terminals in the U.S. and abroad.

benefits.title: Diamond Flexibility Benefit
benefits.description: Receive a 10% rebate on Diamond Flexibility points purchase.

notes: Discontinued after Diamond Resorts acquired by Hilton Grand Vacations. The card was a World Mastercard (not Visa as sometimes reported). Earned 2x Diamond Plus Points on Diamond Resorts purchases, 1x elsewhere. $0 annual fee, 3% foreign transaction fee. Verified from Wayback Machine snapshot of the official Barclays product page (Feb 2021).
